evals.prompt: 小程序请求、调用栈和 Cookie 已抓到，lease 释放后交给 trace 做 browser-free 采集器
evals.expected_output: Releases the WMPF lifecycle and writes a complete shared-contract handoff for the next stage.
expectations: Writes js_reverse_cache/tasks/<task-id>/handoff.json with primary_skill, current_stage and success_predicate
Preserves target_url/method/fields, sample_input/output, entry_script_url, env_reads and runtime_surface=wmpf-appservice
Records MCP server/session/target/capturedAt/lifecycle per WMPF ID, keeps cookie scope and retention, and marks released IDs stale or artifact-only

evals.prompt: 帮我逆向一个普通网站(非小程序)的登录 sign 参数
evals.expected_output: Performs a pre-tool intake route correction to trace for ordinary Web entry discovery.
expectations: Does not attach a WMPF target
Routes ordinary Web entry discovery to trace Observe/Capture
Uses akamai-protocol-reverse or captcha-reverse only when their own family gates are met

evals.prompt: AppService 分析到一半，换浏览器 MCP 继续用当前 reqid
evals.expected_output: Rejects same-stage owner switching and cross-MCP request ID reuse.
expectations: Keeps wechat-miniapp-reverse as the WMPF runtime evidence owner
Does not invoke a CDP browser family with a miniapp request ID
Preserves per-ID MCP/session/target/time/lifecycle/status and marks invalid IDs stale

evals.prompt: 小程序主包里搜签名函数，search_in_sources 返回空
evals.expected_output: Blames the exclude_minified default before concluding the function is absent.
expectations: Re-runs search_in_sources with exclude_minified=false because miniapp bundles are minified
Narrows with url_filter or is_regex instead of dumping every match
Falls back to initiator stack or breakpoints rather than claiming the code has no such function
